title: Differentiable Faithfulness Alignment for Cross-Model Circuit Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2604.24302v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has made it possible to localize circuits underlying specific behaviors in language models, but existing methods are expensive, model-specific, and difficult to scale to larger architectures. We introduce Differentiable Faithfulness Alignment (DFA), a framework that transfers circuit information from a smaller source model to a larger target model through a learned differentiable alignment. DFA projects source-model node importance scores into the target model and trains this mapping with a soft faithfulness objective, avoiding full circuit discovery on the target model. We evaluate DFA on Llama-3 and Qwen-2.5 across six tasks spanning factual retrieval, multiple-choice reasoning, and arithmetic. The strongest results occur when transferring from Llama-3 1B to 3B, where aligned circuits are often competitive with direct node attribution and zero-shot transfer remains effective. Recovery weakens for larger

translated_title: 面向跨模型电路迁移的可微忠实性对齐
translated_abstract: 机械可解释性使得定位语言模型中特定行为背后的电路成为可能，但现有方法成本高昂、依赖于特定模型，且难以扩展到更大的架构。我们提出了可微忠实性对齐（DFA），这是一个通过学习到的可微对齐，将电路信息从较小的源模型迁移到较大目标模型的框架。DFA 将源模型的节点重要性分数投影到目标模型中，并以软忠实性目标训练这一映射，从而避免了在目标模型上进行完整的电路发现。我们在 Llama-3 和 Qwen-2.5 上，针对涵盖事实检索、多项选择推理和算术的六项任务对 DFA 进行了评估。最强的结果出现在从 Llama-3 1B 迁移到 3B 时，此时对齐后的电路通常与直接节点归因相当，且零样本迁移仍然有效。对于更大的模型，恢复效果会有所减弱（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出可微忠实性对齐（DFA）框架，通过可微映射和软忠实性目标将小模型的电路信息高效迁移到大模型，避免了在目标模型上进行代价高昂的完整电路发现。
en_tdlr: DFA is a framework that transfers circuit knowledge from a smaller source model to a larger target model via a learned differentiable alignment trained with a soft faithfulness objective, avoiding costly full circuit discovery on the target model.
